description.name: Twin Element Mode (Ice, Dark)

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Kurasame
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Ice Reaper (0~2), removed after using Ice Reaper two times

description.name: Ice Reaper Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Ice Reaper level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Kurasame]

description.name: Ice Reaper Level
description.text: Keeps track of Ice Reaper level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Kurasame]
